theorems.statement: ∀ (X Y : Type) [MetricSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] [MetricSpace Y] [MeasurableSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y] (m : ℝ) (E : Set X) (f : X → Y) (K : ℝ≥0), 0 ≤ m → LipschitzOnWith K f E → Chapter01.simonHausdorffMeasureReal m (f '' E) ≤ (K : ℝ≥0∞) ^ m * Chapter01.simonHausdorffMeasureReal m E
